Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human bile salt export pump (CHEMBL6020). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, then docs via assays.doc_id, then compound_structures. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (coalesce DOI and PubMed ID preferring DOI), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
